scope: One bounded AB/C semantic repair, full support and geometry evidence, fixed executor. No D authorized until preregistered development gate assessed.

labels.In: Full object OBB inside native drawer cavity (sidewalls AND below rim), upward load-bearing path to drawer, not Held. All supporting movable ancestors must also fit the cavity. A protruding stacked block is NOT In.
labels.Intermediate: 0.02<q<0.18; boundary bands invalid for all three labels. Closed and Open are separate queries, never negations.
labels.Holding: Unchanged bilateral force-bearing finger-family contacts with no external body support, from frozen PhysicalOracle.
labels.model_access: No simulator fields; labels, poses, contacts and scenario condition are evaluator-only.
labels.support_certainty_rule: A complete geometrically contained path with allforces>=.015N and normals>=.55 certifies support; weak parallel contacts cannot invalidate it.

root_split: A/B train,C dev. All paired fixture branches retain same root. Old312windows may be reused for Holding supervision ONLY; their In/drawer labels are not silently migrated.
capture: Complete contacts, body poses, drawer link transform, joint position and old/new labels every30Hz control. Public RGB/proprio allowlist separate. 4-frame causal windows offsets63/42/21/0.
diagnostic_windows: fixture frames63,127; after eachskill+96; intermediate first q<=.14 and first q<=.07; first closed-gripper descend; lower_into_drawer frame63 when available. Probes used for supervised development only.
physical_guard: No teleport after reset, no changed force, collision, externalforce or dynamics; unchanged PhysicalOracle SHA frozen. Layout changes are explicitly paired reset branches, never a simulated transition.

training.architecture: Frozen previous object/scene encoders and temporal GRUs; fresh shared query-conditioned head, five relation types Holding/In/Closed/Open/Intermediate; 9 output facts. Drawer outputs normalized jointly with softmax.
training.sampling: 16 samples from old AB Holding-only root pool,16 from new AB root pool; uniform root then window.
training.loss: Equal group weights Holding BCE, In BCE, drawer3wayCE; inverse class weights from valid AB labels only; missing groups excluded.
training.selection: New C root-macro group loss plus0.2*old C Holding loss, tie earlier. No test selected.

development_gate.audit: All source separation, full evidence and frozen code checks pass. Every requested counterexample family has actual AB/C physical evidence; failed intended fixtures stay recorded.
development_gate.reader: All9 accuracy on new C>=90%; Closed false-positive0 on valid Intermediate/Open; In false-positive0 on valid outside/suspended/protruding counterexamples; all classes have Cpositive+negative support. Old C Holding must not regress by more than1 of84windows.
development_gate.rules: Explicit Closed goal; no unsupported failed transition forced into success effects. Conflicting identical-state outcomes or incomplete failure coverage must be reported and can block an independent test.
development_gate.next_step: Only if audit and perception gates pass, assess one frozen new-root acceptance. Otherwise stop additionalD and produce concrete limitations, no repeated tuning.

old_report_correction: Original7fact6/6 included partiallyopen drawer; strictclosed5/6. Priorreport already separates both.

pilot_correction.when: After16 A-only pilot episodes and before any C collection/training
pilot_correction.cause: A robust support path was incorrectly masked by unrelated weak parallel contacts. An attempted outside-front fixture fell off before the causal windows.
pilot_correction.change: v2_1 accepts certainty if any entire geometrically-contained support path hasforce>=.015 andupnormal>=.55. Retain rawv2 labels and derive additional canonicalv2_1 targets from saved fullphysics. Add a separate outside_front_supported reset condition with center onnativefrontrim; original outside_front failed construction retained.

Paired supervision directly penalizes this failure, without attributing it uniquely to encoder loss.
single_bounded_reader_repair.single_change: Add0.25*mean softplus(1-(Inlogit_positive-Inlogit_negative)),8ABpairs perstep. Everythingelse including base sampler schedule,initial seed,modelarchitecture,1200updates,checkpoints,loss-basedCselection and gate fixed.
